Bash(R --quiet --slave << 'REOF'
library\(readxl\)

all_file <- "/home/ozsol/multiomics-core/outputs/noam_ziv_cells_no_impute/Results_Noam_Ziv_cells_no_impute_t_test_A03/proteomics/Final_results_ALL_P_0.05.xlsx"
all_df <- read_excel\(all_file\)

fc_col <- "linearFC.imputs.Perfuse_vs_NonPerfuse"
pval_col <- "pvalue.imputs.Perfuse_vs_NonPerfuse"
padj_col <- "padj.imputs.Perfuse_vs_NonPerfuse"

cat\("=== Comparing unadjusted p-value vs adjusted p-value filtering ===\\n\\n"\)

# Count at different thresholds
cat\("Proteins with pvalue < 0.05:", sum\(all_df[[pval_col]] < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE\), "\\n"\)
cat\("Proteins with padj < 0.05:", sum\(all_df[[padj_col]] < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE\), "\\n\\n"\)

# For those with pval < 0.05, how many have padj >= 0.05?
pval_sig_padj_not <- sum\(
    \(all_df[[pval_col]] < 0.05\) & \(all_df[[padj_col]] >= 0.05\),
    na.rm = TRUE
\)
cat\("Proteins with pvalue < 0.05 BUT padj >= 0.05:", pval_sig_padj_not, "\\n\\n"\)

# Now check with FC cutoff
cat\("=== With FC cutoff |FC| >= 1 ===\\n"\)
cat\("Proteins with pvalue < 0.05 AND |FC| >= 1:", 
    sum\(\(all_df[[pval_col]] < 0.05\) & \(abs\(all_df[[fc_col]]\) >= 1\), na.rm = TRUE\), "\\n"\)
cat\("Proteins with padj < 0.05 AND |FC| >= 1:", 
    sum\(\(all_df[[padj_col]] < 0.05\) & \(abs\(all_df[[fc_col]]\) >= 1\), na.rm = TRUE\), "\\n\\n"\)

# Difference
pval_fc <- sum\(\(all_df[[pval_col]] < 0.05\) & \(abs\(all_df[[fc_col]]\) >= 1\), na.rm = TRUE\)
padj_fc <- sum\(\(all_df[[padj_col]] < 0.05\) & \(abs\(all_df[[fc_col]]\) >= 1\), na.rm = TRUE\)
diff <- pval_fc - padj_fc
cat\("Difference \(pvalue method - padj method\):", diff, "\\n"\)

REOF)
